body: Storm last night put dents all over the roof and a skylight cracked. Policy HRX-100-4471. How do I start a claim?

subject: Add a driver

body: I bought a duplex in Paragould and need a landlord policy quote.

body: Our agency cannot log into the producer portal since Monday. Agency code 7731.

body: Third time asking about my premium increase. If I don't hear back this week I'm calling the Department of Insurance.

subject: Claim status
body: Checking on claim CL-55821 for my water heater leak. Has an adjuster been assigned?

subject: Card declined
body: My card was declined on the portal. I updated it, can you rerun the payment?

subject: Address change
body: We moved to 412 Cedar Hollow Rd. Please update both home and auto policies.

subject: Very disappointed
body: I've waited two weeks for anyone to call me back about my towing reimbursement. This is unacceptable.

subject: Proof of insurance
body: I need a new ID card for my car, the one in the glovebox expired.

subject: Tree fell on fence
body: A neighbor's oak fell onto our fence in the wind. Is that something I file with you?

subject: Refund after cancellation
body: I cancelled my renters policy on the 1st. When will the unused premium be refunded?

subject: Commission statement
body: Our October commission statement is missing two policies. Who can reconcile it?

subject: New auto policy
body: Looking to switch my two cars to Harbor Ridge. What do you need from me for a quote?

subject: Lawyer
body: My attorney will be contacting you about how my claim was handled. Please confirm who to send correspondence to.

subject: Question
body: Hi, quick question about my account.

body: Hola, quiero saber cuándo vence mi próximo pago de la póliza de auto. Gracias.

subject: Rear-ended at light
body: Someone rear-ended me on Caraway Rd today. Nobody hurt. Other driver's insurer info attached in photo.

subject: Deductible change
body: Can I raise my homeowners deductible to $2,500 to lower my premium?

subject: Business owners policy
body: We're opening a bakery in Searcy. Do you write business owners policies?

subject: Binding authority
body: Can our agency bind a homeowners policy over $600k dwelling coverage or does it need referral?

subject: Payment plan
body: Is a monthly plan available instead of paying the full annual premium?

subject: Hailstorm – multiple homes
body: Our whole street got hit by hail. Three of us are Harbor Ridge customers. How do we each file?

subject: Complaint about adjuster
body: The adjuster was rude and dismissed my photos. I want to file a formal complaint.

subject: Office hours
body: What are your customer service hours on Saturdays?

subject: Remove vehicle
body: Sold my truck. Please take it off my policy as of Friday.

subject: Late fee
body: Why was I charged a late fee when I paid on the due date?

subject: Regulator
body: I have already sent a copy of my complaint to the insurance commissioner. I expect a call.

subject: Flood in basement
body: Water came up through the basement floor after the rain. Is this covered and how do I report it?

subject: Paperless
body: Please switch me to paperless statements.
